name: setup-manaflow-ai-broadsheet-look
description: Broadsheet v0.2, the reading preset, as a drop-in look. What agents produce is writing (plans, reports, diffs, logs), so the hierarchy is built from type, measure and rhythm, not from boxes: reading text at 16 px on a 24 px line in a 560 px column (35 em, 72 characters a line as measured), code at 13 px, chrome at 13 px in 28 px rows, your prompt and the tool cards drawn with a faint wash or a hairline in place of a filled bubble, a sidebar and tab strip one quiet step of lightness off the page with a hairline between them, and color kept for links and status. Built only from public surfaces: two theme files (Broadsheet, light, the default; Broadsheet Dark), settings, and two stylesheets of public tokens. Remove it and everything you had comes back. A look cannot give code its own column or size tool rows apart from reading text, so both follow the reading text here; the README lists what this look does not set.

files.themes/broadsheet-dark.json:
// Broadsheet Dark: the same page at night. A warm near-black page with warm light ink (14.5:1);
// the sidebar, tab strip and docks are the margin, one quiet step of lightness over the page
// (L* 7 against 11, the same hue), with a hairline where margin meets page. That step is
// Broadsheet's two-tone: lightness, never hue. Color is kept for links and focus (a pale ink blue,
// 9.5:1) and status.
{
  "name": "Broadsheet Dark",
  "description": "A reading instrument, Dark: a near-black page, warm ink, a margin-toned sidebar, hairline rules.",

  // The terminal follows the page; the window, sidebar and pages take this theme.
  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: the page. foreground: the ink. selection: a highlighter under the text, not the
  // accent. accent: the link and focus ink.
  "colors": { "background": "#161615", "foreground": "#e9e6df", "selection": "#7b745f", "accent": "#a3bbf5" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  // The terminal: the page and ink above, the cursor in the ink, and sixteen colors at a soft
  // chroma, each readable over the page (the Folio look's palette, solved in OKLCH over a page
  // within one step of this one).
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #161615",
    "foreground = #e9e6df",
    "cursor-color = #e9e6df",
    "cursor-text = #161615",
    "selection-background = #4a4330",
    "selection-foreground = #e9e6df",
    "palette = 0=#474b51",
    "palette = 1=#d4766a",
    "palette = 2=#4ea166",
    "palette = 3=#ab8d27",
    "palette = 4=#6691da",
    "palette = 5=#bf78b6",
    "palette = 6=#0aa0aa",
    "palette = 7=#d4d4d2",
    "palette = 8=#696e74",
    "palette = 9=#fe9a82",
    "palette = 10=#57ca8c",
    "palette = 11=#d5b13a",
    "palette = 12=#95b3ff",
    "palette = 13=#f297da",
    "palette = 14=#08c7dd",
    "palette = 15=#ecedf0"
  ],
  // The terminal face: SF Mono at 13 pt, the code voice's size.
  "terminal.fontFamily": "SF Mono",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  // A plain, opaque page: nothing moves or shows through behind text you are reading.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  // Layout: flat, groups made by tone, spacing and one hairline between the margin and the page
  // (never a card or a gutter); the tab strip in the margin's tone, so the selected tab, in the
  // page's tone, reads as the top of the page it opens.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "appearance.density": "cozy",
  // The emphasis budget: a selected row spends two levers, a neutral wash and weight, never the
  // accent as well.
  "appearance.selection": "neutral",
  // Corners grow by the padding between nested shapes: a control is 4, a tab and a pane 6 (4 plus
  // the 2 px corner padding), a floating panel 8.
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 6,
  "layout.cornerPadding": 2,

  // Proportions, all on the 4 px baseline: chrome text is 13 px on a 20 px line; a row is its line
  // plus 8 (28); the tab strip is a row plus 8 (36); the title bar a row plus 12 (40); the sidebar
  // is 240, three eighths of the 640 px reading column.
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMaxWidth": 200,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinActiveWidth": 160,
  "appearance.metrics.tabMinInactiveWidth": 120,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 240,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 28,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 0,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  // The margin: the sidebar, tab strip, address bar and docks, one step of lightness off the page.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#171614",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#1f1e1c",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#1f1e1c",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#1f1e1c",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.style": "standard",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 0.5,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",

  // The page: the chat, editors, diffs, Markdown, the terminal, Settings and every internal page
  // on the same paper.
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#161615",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,
  // The rule: the ink at about 12% over the page.
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#34322e",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Status: a small dot in the row's own line, not a spinner.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 0.9,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWorkingOnTabs": true,

  // The address field: flat, no glass.
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "off",

  // Motion: color changes settle in 120 ms on an ease-out; nothing slides or bounces under text.
  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast",
  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 120,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "srgb",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "crossfade"
}
